Settings hero subtitle: Make Roblox things feel right again.
Search developer unlocked hint: Developer page unlocked. It is highly recommended not to use it because it is mostly useless.
Old navigation description: In development. Keep disabled unless you are testing it.
Sidebar size description: Drag freely, then release to snap to the nearest mode.
Sidebar collapse menu title: Full to icon only collapse button
Sidebar collapse menu description: Replaces Roblox’s menu icon and toggles the sidebar between full width and icon-only.
Sidebar content list description: Remove items you do not want in the left navigation bar.
Sidebar content empty hint: Open a Roblox page with the left navigation visible to detect sidebar items.
Always show close description: Forces Roblox's sidebar close/menu button to always be visible.
Friend styling description: Restyles the friends carousel with a dark glass card and animated presence ring glow.
Settings sync description: Copy, export, or import your RoPrime settings as JSON. Import replaces all saved settings and reloads the page.
Settings sync import failed: Could not import this file. Choose a valid RoPrime settings JSON export.
Info card body: This extension adds an RoPrime settings panel on your Roblox Account page and can rename some modern Roblox wording back to classic terms.
Developer section description: This page is hidden by default. It is highly recommended not to use it because it is mostly useless.
Custom CSS description: CSS you write here is injected into every Roblox page while RoPrime is enabled.
Enable cosmetics description: Show profile effect previews and purchase options.
Profile picture effects description: Looping Lottie animations on your profile avatar.
Profile effects description: Looping Lottie animations across your profile page.
Profile effect unsupported format: Use a .lottie file (LottieFiles) or a https://lottie.host/… URL.
